## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD9: brainstorm.ui_keywords override semantics are specified (replace the default lexicon); documentation in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md makes the config key discoverable

## TDD Requirement
testing_mode=GREEN: No new test needed — CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md is an instruction/doc file; structural coverage is provided by referential integrity hooks that check doc file accuracy.

## Implementation Steps

1. Edit `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` — add `brainstorm.ui_keywords` to the `[brainstorm]` config section (or create it if absent):

```
### brainstorm.ui_keywords
**Type**: string (comma-separated keywords)
**Default**: internal default surface-lexicon (web, form, screen, page, button, input, UI, dashboard, modal, dialog, navigation, sidebar, dropdown, toggle, menu, layout, component, widget, render, display, click, hover, scroll, responsive)
**Override semantics**: REPLACES the default lexicon entirely (not merged). Set this to restrict or expand detection to project-specific UI keywords.
**Example**: `brainstorm.ui_keywords=form,wizard,panel,chart,grid`
**Used by**: Phase 1 Gate Step 1.5 (UI Intent Detection) in brainstorm SKILL.md
```

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (add brainstorm.ui_keywords section)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] brainstorm.ui_keywords documented in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
  Verify: grep -q 'brainstorm.ui_keywords\|ui_keywords' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Replace semantics documented (not merge)
  Verify: grep -qi 'replace\|replaces' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
